title: The Rider on the White Ridge
summary: After Rowan Hold, Raina and Samuel catch the trio on the Long Mile and agree to stop operating ahead of them. Jessie allows them to travel on the same road only if they remain in sight. During that uneasy new arrangement, Eva spots a solitary Rider on a pale ridge.

panelPlan.text: Wide Long Mile: Raina and Samuel have caught up after Rowan Hold. Their bedrolls remain separate from the rig and they walk a few paces apart, making the new arrangement visibly provisional.

Jessie makes the condition plain: no more disappearing ahead to prepare a town. Raina closes her notebook and gives a short nod. Eva notices a mounted silhouette on the southern ridge while they are still talking.
Brandon looks once at the Rider, sees no immediate problem and keeps walking beside the rig. The others gradually shift attention from the travel arrangement to the figure.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: No notes left for towns. No helpful strangers. No 'accidental' conversations.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: Stay where she can see you and you'll save us all time.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: You say that like I'm the dangerous one.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: There's a rider on the south ridge.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: Then let them have their ridge.

title: Closing Distance
summary: Eva and Raina angle toward the ridge to get a better look. After several minutes of walking, the Rider appears no closer despite terrain that should have reduced the distance.

panelPlan.text: Eva insists they are not chasing the Rider—the road itself is carrying them closer. She and Raina cross a shallow dry wash while Jessie and Samuel remain with the rig.
A foreground rock and ridge notch provide clear visual landmarks. The Rider remains positioned against the same notch.
Eva checks behind them, surprised by how far they have actually walked.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: We're not chasing him. The road is.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: Enough that I wouldn't be asking.

title: The Longer Route
summary: Jessie takes a route that should intersect the Rider's ridge. The landmarks confirm the group is moving correctly, yet the Rider now appears on a farther ridge beyond the first.

panelPlan.text: Raina's hated 'maybe' has barely landed when Jessie identifies the ground they have reached as the ridge they were aiming for. The group follows a clear natural cut toward the southern ridge. Brandon marks the original ridge with a distinctive split stone.
They crest it and find no tracks, rider or recent disturbance.
Across the next basin, the same unreadable silhouette stands against a farther horizon.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: Then you'll hate this too. This was the ridge.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: Could be two people with the same kind of hat.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: Good. Let's keep it that way.

title: When They Stop
summary: Brandon refuses to spend the day chasing a person who has not approached them. The group resumes its original route. Near sunset, the Rider appears on a low rise much closer than before.

panelPlan.text: Jessie's instruction to keep belief suspended lasts only until Eva asks for one more ridge. Brandon turns back toward the road while she argues. Samuel quietly agrees with Brandon.
Hours later the group makes a small evening camp beside the road, the southern ridges now behind them.
Jessie looks up from the fire and sees the Rider standing on a low rise perhaps a few hundred yards away.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: That is not what we just agreed to.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: We finally have something that doesn't make sense.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: It's still a stranger who hasn't asked us for anything.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: You were more useful when you were lying to us.

title: Raina Has Seen It
summary: Raina admits she has seen the same distance behavior before, months earlier, before Samuel began planting identities and before she had confirmed Brandon's route.

panelPlan.text: Eva predictably turns around despite Jessie's warning. Samuel recognizes the remembered location—Red Wash—and the group watches the Rider from camp without approaching. Raina is more unsettled than Eva has ever seen her.
Samuel asks whether this is the figure Raina once refused to explain in her notes.
Raina says she saw a Rider outside Red Wash while pursuing a completely different lead; riding toward it made it seem farther away.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: Months ago. Before Samuel. Before I knew Brandon's route.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: Until my horse was lathered and the rider was farther away.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: Then maybe it isn't following me.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: I didn't say it was following you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: No. You just looked at me.

title: Nearer in the Morning
summary: Nobody pursues the Rider overnight. At first light the figure is gone from the rise, but a fresh silhouette stands on the road behind them, closer than anyone can explain without invoking a second rider or impossible movement.

panelPlan.text: At sunrise Eva reports the ridge empty. Everyone looks underslept; Brandon pours coffee and packs camp instead of standing watch.
The rise is empty at sunrise. Eva visibly relaxes for one second.
Jessie turns toward the road they traveled yesterday. The Rider stands there in the distance, close enough to be unmistakably present but still too far for facial detail.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: Do you want a bad one?
